articles.title: Systematic engineering of Pichia pastoris for high-level production of recombinant human granulocyte-macrophage colony-stimulating factor.
articles.titleZh: 用于高水平生产重组人粒细胞-巨噬细胞集落刺激因子的毕赤酵母系统工程。
articles.authors: Cheng Z, Gong K, Song Y, Guo Z, Guan W.
articles.abstract: Human granulocyte-macrophage colony-stimulating factor (hCSF2) is a clinically important therapeutic glycoprotein with growing market demand, underscoring the need for efficient recombinant production platforms. To enable high-level production of recombinant hCSF2 (rhCSF2), the Pichia pastoris GS115 strain was systematically engineered through multi-copy integration of the expression cassette, screening for suitable secretory signal peptides, and enhancement of protein folding and transport pathways. The combination of multi-copy integration at multiple genomic loci with the combinatorial use of endogenous and exogenous signal peptides proved critical for improving rhCSF2 titers, while reinforcement of the folding and transport machinery further alleviated the bottleneck of protein throughput. Following high-density fermentation in a 3‑L bioreactor, the optimally engineered strain achieved an rhCSF2 titer of 3.4 g/L-markedly exceeding the highest titer previously reported in yeast hosts by an order of magnitude. Importantly, this engineering strategy was successfully extended to a glycoengineered strain SuperMan5, where it enabled production of rhCSF2 with more homogeneous and humanized N‑glycans and a titer of 4.3 g/L under high‑density fermentation condition. Our work demonstrates that the high-yield production of recombinant human therapeutic glycoproteins bearing homogeneous, humanized N-glycans in engineered yeast offers promising prospects.
articles.abstractZh: 人粒细胞巨噬细胞集落刺激因子 (hCSF2) 是一种临床上重要的治疗性糖蛋白，市场需求不断增长，凸显了对高效重组生产平台的需求。为了实现重组 hCSF2 (rhCSF2) 的高水平生产，通过表达盒的多拷贝整合、筛选合适的分泌信号肽以及增强蛋白质折叠和运输途径，系统地改造了毕赤酵母 GS115 菌株。多个基因组位点的多拷贝整合与内源和外源信号肽的组合使用被证明对于提高rhCSF2滴度至关重要，而折叠和运输机制的强化进一步缓解了蛋白质吞吐量的瓶颈。在 3 L 生物反应器中进行高密度发酵后，经过优化改造的菌株的 rhCSF2 滴度达到 3.4 g/L，明显超过之前报道的酵母宿主中的最高滴度一个数量级。重要的是，这种工程策略已成功扩展到糖工程菌株 SuperMan5，从而能够生产出更加均质和人性化的 rhCSF2。

articles.title: Bioproduction potential from industrial and municipal waste streams through open-culture biotechnology.
articles.titleZh: 通过开放培养生物技术，工业和城市废物流的生物生产潜力。
articles.authors: Servin-Balderas I, Wetser K, Hamelers B, Buisman CJN, Contreras-Dávila CA.
articles.abstract: Widespread municipal and industrial feedstocks rich in organics are potential feedstocks for allocating biogenic carbon into circular bioproducts through open-culture biotechnology. In this work, we estimate the production potential of selected biochemicals (methane, lactate, medium-chain carboxylates [MCC]) and biopolymers (extracellular polymeric substances [EPS]; namely flocculant EPS and alginate-like EPS [ALE], and polyhydroxyalkanoates [PHA]). Theoretical and practical carbon and chemical oxygen demand (COD) efficiencies are presented to estimate their bioproduction potential in Europe (EU-27) based on a meta-analysis, feedstock-bioproduct compatibility assessment and Monte Carlo simulations. Potentially compatible feedstocks added up to about 60 and 20 Mton/year of COD and carbon, respectively, and comprised municipal wastewater, food waste and industrial wastewaters from the food (dairy, beverages, yeast and sugar) and pulp and paper (pulp, cardboard) sectors. Methane, a highly reduced molecule (oxygen/carbon ratio = 0), is the bioproduct that can recover the most COD (∼36 Mton COD/year) and carbon (∼7 Mton carbon/year) from the feedstocks, whereas oxygen-rich lactate (O/C = 1) showed the highest mass flux potential (∼12 metric Mton/year). From the biopolymers, flocculant EPS had the highest bioproduction potential (∼11 Mton COD/year). The estimated potentials could supply a significant fraction of the global market demand for e.g., plastic applications from lactate and PHA; or European targets for e.g., biomethane or sustainable aviation fuels (SAF) from MCC. A supply potential of EPS-based products in excess of their market applications demand indicate that further market development may be required. This study illustrates the opportunities for future commercialization of open-culture bioproducts.

articles.title: Construction and systematic engineering of Saccharomyces cerevisiae for efficient de novo biosynthesis of pentostatin.
articles.titleZh: 用于有效从头生物合成喷司他丁的酿酒酵母的构建和系统工程。
articles.authors: Bai M, Liu Z, Wang C, Chen Y, Lu J.
articles.abstract: Pentostatin is a potent adenosine deaminase inhibitor, yet its industrial application is hindered by low extraction yields and complex chemical synthesis. Here, we report an efficient de novo biosynthesis platform for pentostatin in Saccharomyces cerevisiae. Starting with the heterologous expression of cns3 from Cordyceps militaris, we optimized the cell factory via promoter engineering, multicopy integration, and AAH1 knockout. This integration strain achieved a maximum pentostatin titer of 16.28 mg/L in shake-flask cultivation, representing a 19.38-fold improvement over our initial production. Separately, to alleviate severe product toxicity, we implemented flux balance analysis (FBA)-guided transporter engineering; the engineered strain expressing the episomal efflux pump Cns4 yielded a titer of 8.27 mg/L while significantly accelerating the production process. Molecular docking revealed a distinct binding cavity where key residues (e.g., Asp296, Ala292) capture pentostatin via specific hydrogen bonds and hydrophobic interactions. Furthermore, transcriptomics demonstrated that Cns4 globally reprograms carbon and energy metabolism to boost precursor supply and cellular robustness. This work integrates structural insights with systems metabolic engineering, providing a generalizable paradigm for biosynthesizing toxic nucleoside natural products.
articles.abstractZh: 喷司他丁是一种有效的腺苷脱氨酶抑制剂，但其工业应用因提取率低和化学合成复杂而受到阻碍。在这里，我们报告了一种在酿酒酵母中有效的喷司他丁生物合成平台。从蛹虫草中cns3的异源表达开始，我们通过启动子工程、多拷贝整合和AAH1敲除来优化细胞工厂。该整合菌株在摇瓶培养中喷司他丁最大滴度达到16.28mg/L，比我们最初的产量提高了19.38倍。另外，为了减轻严重的产品毒性，我们实施了通量平衡分析（FBA）引导的转运蛋白工程；表达游离外排泵 Cns4 的工程菌株产生了 8.27mg/L 的滴度，同时显着加速了生产过程。分子对接揭示了一个独特的结合腔，其中关键残基（例如，Asp296、Ala292）通过特定的氢键和疏水相互作用捕获喷司他丁。此外，转录组学表明，Cns4 在全球范围内重新编程碳和能量代谢，以提高前体供应和细胞稳健性。

articles.title: Exploring biotransformation of phenolic compounds during lactic acid fermentation of grape marc and their fate following simulated in vitro digestion.
articles.titleZh: 探索葡萄渣乳酸发酵过程中酚类化合物的生物转化及其模拟体外消化后的命运。
articles.authors: Liu Z, Holland B, Barrow CJ, Suleria HAR.
articles.abstract: Grape marc (GM), a winemaking byproduct, has excellent antioxidant properties. Using GM as a lactic acid bacteria (LAB) fermentation medium could contribute to health benefits while managing waste volume. This study optimised a LAB fermentation system using GM and investigated different strains' impact on phenolics content and antioxidant capacity during fermentation and simulated gastrointestinal digestion. Our findings indicated that while raw GM could support growth, its intrinsic carbon limitation and high phenolic load necessitated yeast and glucose to 'prime' the metabolic pathways toward efficient homofermentative lactic acid production and biotransformation. During fermentation, flavonoids and tannins were significantly degraded, while the recovery and release of measurable anthocyanins was enhanced through enzymatic modification of the matrix. LC-ESI-QTOF-MS/MS analysis revealed changes in specific phenolics during degradation and transformation. In vitro digestion increased the total phenolic content and antioxidant activity of fermented GM compared to unfermented samples. These findings indicate that fermentation enhances the functionality of phenolics, making LAB-fermented GM a promising phenolic-rich functional ingredient for health-promoting applications in food, pharmaceuticals, and cosmetics, while also contributing to sustainable development. Furthermore, this biotransformation strategy demonstrates significant potential for extending to other phenolic-rich agro-industrial residues, such as olive mill wastewater, supporting broader circular economy goals.

articles.title: Synergistic Effects of Cepharanthine and Amphotericin B Against Candida albicans by Targeting PMP3-Mediated Sphingolipid Biosynthesis and Membrane Disruption.
articles.titleZh: Cepharanthine 和两性霉素 B 通过靶向 PMP3 介导的鞘脂生物合成和膜破坏对白色念珠菌产生协同作用。
articles.authors: Wang S, Zhang Q, Li Q, Wang G, Tan X, Liang Y, Zhu C.
articles.abstract: Candida albicans is a major opportunistic fungal pathogen causing various mucosal infections, including oral candidiasis, poses challenges in current antifungal therapy because of limited number of drugs, increased pathogen resistance, and notable toxicity associated with existing medications. Combination therapy is crucial for optimizing treatment outcomes. In this study, cepharanthine (CEP) was explored as an adjunct to amphotericin B (AmB) to elucidate the potential mechanism of action of drug combinations against Candida albicans. The minimum inhibitory concentration (MIC) was determined using the checkerboard method, and the fractional inhibitory concentration index (FICI) was computed. The combination of cepharanthine and amphotericin B had a synergistic effect (FICI < 0.5) on both standard strains and 73 clinical strains of Candida albicans, leading to significant inhibition of metabolism, hyphal growth, and biofilm formation. Transcriptome sequencing, membrane permeability studies, assessment of mitochondrial membrane potential, and scanning electron microscopy revealed that cepharanthine primarily targeted the membrane structure of Candida albicans. RT‒qPCR analysis demonstrated that cepharanthine in combination with amphotericin B suppressed sphingolipid synthesis by downregulating the expression of the plasma membrane-associated gene PMP3, thereby compromising cell membrane integrity. Molecular docking model analysis further supported the binding affinity of both drugs to the PMP3 protein. The combined use of cepharanthine and amphotericin B presents a promising approach for the clinical management of oral candidiasis.
articles.abstractZh: 白色念珠菌是一种主要的机会性真菌病原体，可引起包括口腔念珠菌病在内的各种粘膜感染，由于药物数量有限、病原体耐药性增加以及与现有药物相关的显着毒性，对当前的抗真菌治疗提出了挑战。联合治疗对于优化治疗结果至关重要。在这项研究中，探索了千金藤素 (CEP) 作为两性霉素 B (AmB) 的辅助剂，以阐明药物组合对抗白色念珠菌的潜在作用机制。使用棋盘法测定最低抑菌浓度（MIC），并计算分数抑菌浓度指数（FICI）。千金藤素和两性霉素 B 的组合对白色念珠菌的两种标准菌株和 73 种临床菌株具有协同作用（FICI < 0.5），导致代谢、菌丝生长和生物膜形成的显着抑制。转录组测序、膜通透性研究、线粒体膜电位评估和扫描电子显微镜显示，千金藤素主要针对白色念珠菌的膜结构。 RT-qPCR 分析恶魔

articles.title: Synthetic yeast-bacterium consortium enables co-inducible relayed synthesis of chemicals.
articles.titleZh: 合成酵母-细菌联盟实现了化学品的共诱导中继合成。
articles.authors: Xu M, Yu J, Chen X, Li X, Guo Y, Qian Z, Liu Q, Ren Y, Lu J, Chen X, Yang Y, Cai M.
articles.abstract: Microbial coculture can integrate advantages and overcome the metabolic imbalance of individual species. Programming strain interactions represents a common routine for synthetic microbial communities with distinct species, which causes difficulties and redundant workloads in interaction construction before being available as chassis hosts. This study explores yeast-bacterium consortium without engineered interactions for the co-inducible relayed synthesis of natural products. The Komagataella phaffii-Escherichia coli consortium is explored for co-growth under selected conditions. Low-level glucose- and blue light-responsive transcriptional systems are rebuilt separately for each host, allowing single-signal co-induced activation of compound synthesis in coculture. Pathway redirection, genome mining, and rewiring of key targets for acyl donor degradation result in efficient production of the reporter molecule simvastatin (26.2 mg l-1) through living consortium cultured on simple carbon source. Inducible biosynthesis of another reporter compound (2S)-naringenin (165.6 mg l-1) further validates the extendibility of this community. The described platform represents a breakthrough in engineering microbial consortium for biosynthesis.
articles.abstractZh: 微生物共培养可以整合优势，克服单个物种的代谢不平衡。对菌株相互作用进行编程代表了具有不同物种的合成微生物群落的常见例程，这在用作底盘宿主之前导致了相互作用构建中的困难和冗余工作量。这项研究探索了酵母-细菌联合体在没有工程相互作用的情况下进行天然产物的共诱导中继合成。探索了 Komagataella phaffii-大肠杆菌联合体在选定条件下的共同生长。为每个宿主单独重建低水平的葡萄糖和蓝光响应转录系统，允许在共培养中单信号共同诱导化合物合成的激活。路径重定向、基因组挖掘和酰基供体降解的关键靶标的重新连接导致通过在简单碳源上培养的活体联合体高效生产报告分子辛伐他汀（26.2 mg l-1）。另一种报告化合物 (2S)-柚皮素 (165.6 mg l-1) 的诱导生物合成进一步验证了该群落的可扩展性。所描述的平台代表了一个突破

articles.title: The Diversifying Distribution Trends of Maturing CRISPR Technologies by Addgene.
articles.titleZh: Addgene 成熟 CRISPR 技术的多样化分布趋势。
articles.authors: Shepard A, Minones-Moyano E, Mork C, Pyhtila B, Barrangou R.
articles.abstract: Since the advent of Cas9-based CRISPR technologies in 2012, there has been a remarkable growth in genome editing research, literature, applications, and translational impact. Much of this research has been fueled by the global dissemination of CRISPR plasmids through nonprofit distribution by Addgene, as both a repository and distributor of enabling biological material. Recently, key milestones have been reached, with over 20,000 plasmids deposited by over 1,000 labs, being distributed over 300,000 times globally. The driving trends reflect multidimensional diversification in terms of effectors (Cas9, Cas12 and beyond), editing modalities (base editing, prime editing, epigenetic modification, CRISPRi/a), and deployment across phylogenetic groups (mammalian, bacterial, plant, yeast, insects, and more). Noteworthy, guide RNA and HDR templates account for the bulk of deposits, while cloning backbones are the most requested, and lentiviral plasmids comprise the majority of expression material. The data reflect a continued diversification of the CRISPR-based toolbox, robust interest in genome editing applications across the tree of life, maturation in terms of adoption, and rising relative distribution beyond the USA and China, with Addgene continuing to play a critical role in access to equitable and disruptive technologies.
articles.abstractZh: 自 2012 年基于 Cas9 的 CRISPR 技术出现以来，基因组编辑研究、文献、应用和转化影响取得了显着增长。这项研究的大部分内容是由 Addgene 作为生物材料储存库和分销商的非营利性分销机构在全球范围内传播 CRISPR 质粒所推动的。最近，我们已经达到了重要的里程碑，1,000 多个实验室保藏了 20,000 多个质粒，在全球分发了超过 300,000 次。驱动趋势反映了效应子（Cas9、Cas12 等）、编辑方式（碱基编辑、prime 编辑、表观遗传修饰、CRISPRi/a）以及跨系统发育群体（哺乳动物、细菌、植物、酵母、昆虫等）的多维多样化。值得注意的是，指导RNA和HDR模板占沉积物的大部分，而克隆骨架是最需要的，而慢病毒质粒则占表达材料的大部分。这些数据反映了基于 CRISPR 的工具箱的持续多样化、对整个生命树的基因组编辑应用的浓厚兴趣、采用方面的成熟以及相关性的不断上升。

articles.title: Fungal polyketide biosynthesis as a platform for designer natural products.
articles.titleZh: 真菌聚酮化合物生物合成作为设计天然产品的平台。
articles.authors: Lin P, Fu Z, Li Y, Yoon YJ, Lee SY.
articles.abstract: Covering: 2010 to 2025Polyketides constitute a vast family of structurally and functionally diverse natural products that underpin numerous pharmaceuticals, nutraceuticals, and materials. Among them, fungal typve I iterative polyketide synthases (iPKSs) orchestrate highly programmable catalytic cycles that transform simple acyl-CoA precursors into architecturally complex molecules. Understanding the programming logic of these multidomain enzymes has revealed how chain-extension, reduction, and cyclization patterns are encoded, offering a foundation for rational pathway engineering. Recent advances in structural biology, cryo-electron microscopy (cryo-EM) analysis, and computational modelling have clarified the conformational dynamics of iPKSs and their collaborating enzymes, while combinatorial biosynthetic strategies now enable the creation of non-natural scaffolds and expanded chemical diversity. Parallel progress in fungal and yeast cell-factory engineering-spanning metabolic rewiring, organelle compartmentalization, and dynamic control-has substantially improved the efficiency and scalability of polyketide production. This review integrates mechanistic insights with biotechnological innovation, highlighting emerging rules for programmable PKS design and discussing future directions toward AI-assisted, high-throughput platforms for sustainable industrial biosynthesis of fungal polyketides.
articles.abstractZh: 覆盖范围：2010年至2025年聚酮化合物构成了一个结构和功能多样化的天然产品大家族，支撑着众多药物、营养保健品和材料。其中，真菌 I 型迭代聚酮合酶 (iPKS) 协调高度可编程的催化循环，将简单的酰基辅酶 A 前体转化为结构复杂的分子。了解这些多域酶的编程逻辑揭示了链延伸、还原和环化模式是如何编码的，为合理的途径工程提供了基础。结构生物学、冷冻电子显微镜 (cryo-EM) 分析和计算模型的最新进展阐明了 iPKS 及其协作酶的构象动力学，而组合生物合成策略现在能够创建非天然支架并扩大化学多样性。真菌和酵母细胞工厂工程（涵盖代谢重连、细胞器区室化和动态控制）的并行进展极大地提高了聚酮化合物生产的效率和可扩展性。这篇综述将机制见解与生物技术相结合

articles.title: High-titer microbial lipid fermentation and extractive recovery by cell wall-weakened Trichosporon cutaneum strain and wheat straw sugar syrup feedstock.
articles.titleZh: 通过细胞壁弱化的皮肤毛孢子菌菌株和麦草糖浆原料进行高滴度微生物脂质发酵和提取物回收。
articles.authors: Umutumwa EP, Huang Y, Pan L, Zhang B, Bao J.
articles.abstract: Lignocellulosic biomass is a promising feedstock for sustainable microbial lipid production; however, its utilization is hindered by low fermentation performance and inefficient lipid recovery. In this study, an integrated strategy combining enzyme-mediated adaptive evolution combined with centrifugal fractionation was employed to generate the oleaginous yeast strain Trichosporon cutaneum YY52E, exhibiting enhanced lipid accumulation and reduced cell wall integrity. The lipid titer reached 60.1 g/L in fed-batch fermentation, with a yield of 0.3 g/g sugars, using wheat straw sugar syrup prepared by dry acid pretreatment, enzymatic hydrolysis, biodetoxification, solid/liquid separation and concentration. Solvent-assisted fermentation coupled with direct solvent extraction enabled 94.2% of lipid recovery without cell harvesting and acid lysis. This study provides an integrated bioprocess for high-titer microbial lipid production and efficient lipid recovery from lignocellulosic biomass.
articles.abstractZh: 木质纤维素生物质是可持续微生物脂质生产的有前途的原料；然而，其利用受到低发酵性能和低效脂质回收的阻碍。在本研究中，采用酶介导的适应性进化与离心分离相结合的综合策略来产生产油酵母菌株皮肤毛孢子菌YY52E，其表现出脂质积累增强和细胞壁完整性降低。采用干酸预处理、酶解、生物解毒、固液分离、浓缩制备的麦草糖浆，分批补料发酵，脂质滴度达到60.1 g/L，糖产量0.3 g/g。溶剂辅助发酵与直接溶剂萃取相结合，无需收获细胞和酸裂解即可回收 94.2% 的脂质。这项研究提供了一种用于高滴度微生物脂质生产和从木质纤维素生物质中有效回收脂质的集成生物工艺。

articles.title: Identification of Salt-Tolerant Germplasm and Salt-Responsive Genes in <i>Brassica napus</i> Through Phenotypic and Transcriptomic Analyses.
articles.titleZh: 通过表型和转录组分析鉴定甘蓝型油菜耐盐种质和盐响应基因。
articles.authors: Li L, Zhang Q, Tang L, Xiao G, Deng L, Zhang Z.
articles.abstract: China's edible oil self-sufficiency rate is only about 30%, and approximately 100 million acres of saline-alkali land are potentially available for rapeseed cultivation. However, salt stress severely inhibits rapeseed growth and yield, making the breeding of salt-tolerant varieties and the study of underlying molecular mechanisms urgent priorities. In this study, 1609 Brassica napus accessions were screened for salt tolerance, and the highly salt-tolerant material 'Xiangnong Saline-Alkali Oil No. 1' (XNSA01) was identified. Subsequent physiological, hormonal, transcriptomic, and functional analyses were conducted to characterize its salt-tolerance mechanisms. Salt stress significantly activated antioxidant defense and stress-related hormone responses in XNSA01, accompanied by significant accumulation of proline, abscisic acid, and salicylic acid. Transcriptome analysis identified five candidate salt-responsive genes, among which BnaA10g15320D, BnaA02g04730D, and BnaC07g08360D were closely associated with antioxidant enzyme activities and endogenous hormone contents. In particular, BnaA02g04730D showed a significant negative correlation with MDA content. Yeast heterologous expression and transgenic validation further demonstrated that BnaA02g04730D enhanced salt tolerance by increasing antioxidant enzyme activities and reducing membrane lipid peroxidation. These findings provide a useful basis for the breeding of salt-tolerant rapeseed varieties and for further investigation of salt-tolerance mechanisms in B. napus.
articles.abstractZh: 我国食用油自给率仅30%左右，约有1亿亩盐碱地可用于油菜种植。然而，盐胁迫严重抑制油菜生长和产量，耐盐品种选育及其分子机制研究刻不容缓。本研究对1609份甘蓝型油菜材料进行耐盐性筛选，鉴定出高耐盐材料“湘农盐碱油1号”（XNSA01）。随后进行了生理、激素、转录组和功能分析，以表征其耐盐机制。盐胁迫显着激活 XNSA01 中的抗氧化防御和应激相关激素反应，并伴有脯氨酸、脱落酸和水杨酸的显着积累。转录组分析确定了5个候选盐响应基因，其中BnaA10g15320D、BnaA02g04730D和BnaC07g08360D与抗氧化酶活性和内源激素含量密切相关。特别是，BnaA02g04730D与MDA含量呈显着负相关。酵母异源表达

articles.title: Oncogenic Gα signaling requires AP-3-dependent recruitment to the endolysosomal compartment.
articles.titleZh: 致癌 Gα 信号传导需要 AP-3 依赖性募集至内溶酶体区室。
articles.journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America
articles.authors: Shettigar M, Moulière S, Isenegger L, DeVine AL, Gstalder C, Koduri V, Doench JG, Ksander B, Garcia-Marcos M, Kaelin WG, Haq R.
articles.abstract: G protein-coupled receptors (GPCRs) constitute the largest superfamily of cell-surface receptors, yet the spatial constraints governing their signaling remain poorly defined. Here, we demonstrate that Gα, an essential downstream component of GPCR signaling, undergoes a spatial shift from the plasma membrane to the endolysosomal compartment upon its constitutive activation. Using a genome-wide CRISPR screen, we identify the adaptor protein AP-3 as the essential mediator of this trafficking event. Loss of AP-3-dependent recruitment impairs Gα-driven signaling and proliferation in uveal melanoma cells harboring oncogenic Gα mutations. We further identify a highly evolutionarily conserved AP-3 binding motif in all Gα proteins, present from yeast to humans. Disrupting this site causes Gα mislocalization and potently suppresses tumor growth and metastasis in vivo. Conversely, tethering Gα to the endolysosomal membrane is sufficient to rescue oncogenic signaling. Our findings reveal that endolysosomal recruitment is a fundamental, conserved requirement for Gα activity, uncovering a spatial vulnerability that may be exploited to target dysregulated G-protein signaling in human disease.
articles.abstractZh: G 蛋白偶联受体 (GPCR) 构成了最大的细胞表面受体超家族，但控制其信号传导的空间限制仍然不明确。在这里，我们证明 Gα（GPCR 信号传导的重要下游成分）在其组成性激活后经历从质膜到内溶酶体区室的空间转移。使用全基因组 CRISPR 筛选，我们确定接头蛋白 AP-3 是该贩运事件的重要介质。 AP-3 依赖性募集的缺失会损害含有致癌性 Gα 突变的葡萄膜黑色素瘤细胞中 Gα 驱动的信号传导和增殖。我们进一步在从酵母到人类的所有 Gα 蛋白中鉴定出高度进化保守的 AP-3 结合基序。破坏该位点会导致 Gα 错误定位，并有效抑制体内肿瘤生长和转移。相反，将 Gα 束缚在内溶酶体膜上足以挽救致癌信号。我们的研究结果表明，内溶酶体募集是 Gα 活性的一个基本的、保守的要求，揭示了一个空间脆弱性，可用于针对人类疾病中失调的 G 蛋白信号传导。

articles.title: Unlocking Antioxidant Potential in Wheat By-Products Through Microbial Bioprocessing: An Integrated Extraction-QUENCHER Assessment.
articles.titleZh: 通过微生物生物加工释放小麦副产品的抗氧化潜力：综合提取-淬灭剂评估。
articles.authors: Sanna V, Tolu V, Piu PP, Sanna M, Piras D, Fois S, Braca A, Roggio T, Catzeddu P.
articles.abstract: Wheat milling by-products are nutrient-rich sidestreams whose valorization is limited by low phenolic bioaccessibility and high phytate levels. This study investigates how sourdough fermentation using a mixed starter (Lactiplantibacillus plantarum, Saccharomyces cerevisiae, and Wickerhamomyces anomalus) modulates the functional properties of whole wheat germ (WWG), defatted wheat germ (DWG), defatted wheat bran (DWB), and wheat middlings (WMs), tested alone or blended with 20% semolina. Fermentation performed shifts in a substrate-dependent manner: it reduced phytic acid content by up to 60% in WWG and WMs while increasing free amino nitrogen (FAN) up to 2.6 mg/g d.b. Conversely, defatted matrices (DWG and DWB) exhibited structural resistance, showing stagnation in both phytate degradation and FAN accumulation, likely due to industrial hexane-treatment limitations. Total phenolic content (TPC) and antioxidant activities (DPPH, ABTS, FRAP) assessed via the extraction-free QUENCHER method revealed that conventional solvent extraction underestimates the bioactive potential by 40-60%. Fermentation significantly enhanced radical-scavenging activity across all matrices. However, ferric-reducing power (FRAP) increased exclusively in WWG and WMs (up to 18-19 µmol Fe (II)E/g d.b.), proving strictly dependent on phytic acid degradation. A Principal Component Analysis (PCA) revealed a clear trend toward convergence in the functional profiles of heterogeneous matrices during long-term bioprocessing. Controlled sourdough fermentation represents an effective strategy to upcycle specific cereal sidestreams into functional ingredients, though industrial defatting constraints require structural optimization.
articles.abstractZh: 小麦加工副产品是营养丰富的副产品，其价值受到低酚类生物可及性和高植酸含量的限制。本研究探讨了使用混合发酵剂（植物乳杆菌、酿酒酵母和异常威克哈姆酵母）进行酸面团发酵如何调节全麦胚芽 (WWG)、脱脂麦芽 (DWG)、脱脂麦麸 (DWB) 和小麦中粉 (WM) 的功能特性，单独测试或与 20% 粗粒小麦粉混合。发酵以底物依赖性方式发生变化：WWG 和 WM 中的植酸含量降低高达 60%，同时游离氨基氮 (FAN) 增加高达 2.6 mg/g d.b。相反，脱脂基质（DWG 和 DWB）表现出结构抗性，表明植酸盐降解和 FAN 积累均停滞，这可能是由于工业己烷处理的限制。通过免萃取 QUENCHER 方法评估的总酚含量 (TPC) 和抗氧化活性（DPPH、ABTS、FRAP）表明，传统溶剂萃取低估了 40-60% 的生物活性潜力。发酵显着增强了所有基质的自由基清除活性。然而，铁-r

articles.title: Co-expression of AkCSLA3 and AkMSR1 correlates with altered free monosaccharide pools in Pichia pastoris.
articles.titleZh: AkCSLA3 和 AkMSR1 的共表达与毕赤酵母中游离单糖库的改变相关。
articles.authors: Shi Y, Li D, Chu H, Gu X, Luo C.
articles.abstract: BackgroundKonjac glucomannan (KGM) is a high-viscosity, water-soluble dietary fiber that accumulates predominantly in the corms of Amorphophallus konjac (A. konjac). Due to its excellent gel-forming and water-retention properties, KGM is widely used in the food industry. The biosynthesis of KGM involves the coordinated action of cellulose synthase-like (CSL) enzymes and mannan synthesis-related (MSR) proteins. However, the regulatory mechanisms and functional interactions between these components remain poorly understood in A. konjac.ResultsIn this study, we systematically characterized the AkCSLA gene family in A. konjac and identified 11 members. Transcriptomic analysis revealed that AkCSLA2 and AkCSLA3 were highly expressed during corm expansion and maturation, coinciding with active KGM accumulation. Subcellular localization assays in Nicotiana benthamiana (N. benthamiana) demonstrated that both AkCSLA2 and AkCSLA3 proteins localized to the plasma membrane, endoplasmic reticulum, and Golgi apparatus. Protein interaction analyses using yeast two-hybrid and co-immunoprecipitation assays showed that AkMSR1, a homologue of Arabidopsis thaliana MSR1, specifically interacted with AkCSLA3 but not with AkCSLA2. Functional studies in Pichia pastoris (P. pastoris) revealed that co-expression of AkCSLA3 and AkMSR1 significantly increased free mannose and glucose accumulation, with mannose levels elevated more than threefold compared to AkCSLA3 alone. These findings demonstrate that AkMSR1 modulates monosaccharide pools in an AkCSLA3-dependent manner in yeast.ConclusionThis study demonstrates the physical interaction between AkCSLA3 and AkMSR1 and reveals that their co-expression in P. pastoris significantly reshapes monosaccharide content. These findings provide novel insights into the molecular regulation of KGM biosynthesis and identify potential targets for the genetic enhancement of KGM content in A. konjac.
articles.abstractZh: 背景魔芋葡甘聚糖（KGM）是一种高粘度、水溶性膳食纤维，主要积累在魔芋（A. konjac）的球茎中。由于其优异的凝胶形成和保水性能，KGM 被广泛应用于食品工业。 KGM 的生物合成涉及纤维素合酶样 (CSL) 酶和甘露聚糖合成相关 (MSR) 蛋白的协调作用。然而，对于魔芋中这些成分之间的调控机制和功能相互作用仍然知之甚少。结果在这项研究中，我们系统地表征了魔芋中的 AkCSLA 基因家族，并鉴定了 11 个成员。转录组分析显示，AkCSLA2 和 AkCSLA3 在球茎扩张和成熟过程中高度表达，与活跃的 KGM 积累相一致。本塞姆氏烟草 (N.benthamiana) 的亚细胞定位测定表明，AkCSLA2 和 AkCSLA3 蛋白均定位于质膜、内质网和高尔基体。使用酵母双杂交和免疫共沉淀测定进行的蛋白质相互作用分析表明，AkMSR1（拟南芥 MSR1 的同源物）与 AkC 特异性相互作用

articles.title: Effect of <i>Saccharomyces cerevisiae</i> fermentation postbiotic supplementation on metagenomics of digital dermatitis lesions in lactating Holstein cows.
articles.titleZh: 酿酒酵母发酵后生元补充剂对泌乳荷斯坦奶牛指端皮炎病变宏基因组学的影响。
articles.authors: Henige M, Anklam K, Yoon I, Wheeler J, Dawson G, Döpfer D.
articles.abstract: Digital dermatitis (DD) is the leading cause of lameness in cattle, posing major animal welfare and economic concerns. Effective prevention strategies are increasingly important given emerging antimicrobial resistance associated with common DD treatments. Supplementation with Saccharomyces cerevisiae fermentation postbiotics (SCFP) has been shown to enhance innate immunity and reduce DD lesion development. This study evaluated the effect of a commercial SCFP supplement on the microbial composition of DD lesions using shotgun metagenomic sequencing to characterize microbial communities and associated antimicrobial resistance genes. Beta diversity analysis revealed that stage M4 DD lesions from SCFP-supplemented cows had a trend for different microbial compositions compared with controls (P = 0.051). At the genus level, M2 lesions were found to have statistically significant lower abundance of the genera Desulfovibrio, Pseudomonas, Staphylococcus, Anaerotignum, Caproicibacterium, and Bacteroides in the SCFP treatment group compared with the control (P Fusobacterium, Citricoccus, Listeria, and Fundicoccus as compared with the control (P Blautia and Petrimonas in the SCFP treatment group compared with the control (P Desulfovibrio sp. G11, Anaerotignum sp. MB30-C6, Caproicibacterium argilliputei, and Prevotella intermedia in the SCFP treatment group compared with the control (P Fundicoccus culcitae and Helcococcus ovis as compared with the control (P Saccharomyces cerevisiae fermentation postbiotics (SCFP) has the potential to alter the microbial ecology of DD lesions. Importantly, this work identifies antimicrobial resistance genes within DD lesions, underscoring the limitations of antibiotic-based control strategies. By linking nutritional supplementation to changes in microbial communities and resistance gene profiles, this study advances understanding of non-antibiotic approaches to disease mitigation and supports the development of sustainable, microbiome-informed management practices in food animal production.
articles.abstractZh: 数码皮炎 (DD) 是牛跛行的主要原因，造成重大的动物福利和经济问题。鉴于与常见 DD 治疗相关的新出现的抗菌药物耐药性，有效的预防策略变得越来越重要。补充酿酒酵母发酵后生元 (SCFP) 已被证明可以增强先天免疫力并减少 DD 病变的发展。本研究使用鸟枪法宏基因组测序来表征微生物群落和相关抗菌素耐药性基因，评估了商业 SCFP 补充剂对 DD 病变微生物组成的影响。 Beta 多样性分析显示，与对照组相比，补充 SCFP 的奶牛的 M4 DD 阶段病变具有不同微生物组成的趋势 (P = 0.051)。在属水平上，与对照组相比，SCFP 治疗组中的 M2 病灶中脱硫弧菌属、假单胞菌属、葡萄球菌属、厌氧菌属、己杆菌属和拟杆菌属（P 梭杆菌属、柠檬球菌属、李斯特菌属和胃底球菌属）的丰度具有统计显着性降低（SCFP 治疗组中的 P Blautia 和 Petrimonas）

articles.title: Effects of a blend of Saccharomyces cerevisiae fermentation-derived postbiotic and essential oil supplementation on the performance of transition dairy cows.
articles.titleZh: 酿酒酵母发酵后生元和精油混合补充剂对围产期奶牛生产性能的影响。
articles.authors: Saikumar S, Arriola K, Alvarado-Vargas AE, Siregar MU, Alfaro-Diaz N, Barahona AO, Salvatierra S, Sahay B, Vaswani S, Cayetano A, Yoon I, Vyas D.
articles.abstract: We aimed to evaluate the effects of a blend (PE) of Saccharomyces cerevisiae fermentation-derived postbiotics (SCFP) and essential oil compounds (EO) on performance, rumen fermentation profile, nutrient digestibility, nitrogen metabolism, blood metabolic profile and immune parameters in transition dairy cows from -35 d to 63 d postpartum. Sixty-two multiparous Holsteins, at 245 ± 3 d of pregnancy, were assigned to control (CON; n = 31) or a blend of SCFP and essential oil compounds (PE; n = 31) in a randomized block design. Diets were formulated based on CNCPS guidelines. The treatment group was top-dressed with PE (25 g/d) on the ad libitum-fed TMR to individual cows. During the prepartum period, BCS and BW were measured weekly. For lactating cows, DMI, milk yield, and BW were recorded daily; milk samples were collected twice weekly for component analysis; and BCS was recorded weekly. Colostrum quality was measured using a Brix refractometer. Rumen fluid was collected at weeks -5, -2, and +2 for fermentation profile analysis. Fecal and urine samples were collected at weeks -4, -1, +2, +4, and +6 for digestibility and nitrogen metabolism analysis. Blood samples were collected on d -35, -28, -14, -7, +3, +7, +14, and +21 relative to calving. Data were analyzed using the GLIMMIX procedure in SAS using treatment, week, interactions, and block as fixed factors, while cows nested in treatment were used as a random factor. Significance was declared at P ≤ 0.05 with tendencies noted at 0.05
articles.abstractZh: 我们的目的是评估酿酒酵母发酵后生元 (SCFP) 和精油化合物 (EO) 的混合物 (PE) 对产后 -35 天至 63 天过渡期奶牛的生产性能、瘤胃发酵特性、营养物质消化率、氮代谢、血液代谢特性和免疫参数的影响。在随机区组设计中，62 只经产荷斯坦牛在怀孕 245 ± 3 d 时被分配为对照（CON；n = 31）或 SCFP 和精油化合物的混合物（PE；n = 31）。饮食是根据 CNCPS 指南制定的。治疗组在每头奶牛随意饲喂的TMR上追施PE（25克/天）。在产前期间，每周测量一次 BCS 和 BW。对于泌乳奶牛，每天记录干物质指数（DMI）、产奶量和体重；每周两次采集牛奶样本进行成分分析；每周记录BCS。使用白利糖度折光仪测量初乳质量。在第-5、-2和+2周收集瘤胃液用于发酵概况分析。在-4、-1、+2、+4和+6周收集粪便和尿液样本用于消化率和氮代谢分析。血液样本于 d 采集

articles.title: Enhancing carotenoid production in Chlorella sorokiniana through the protein-protein interaction between ORANGE and PSY.
articles.titleZh: 通过 ORANGE 和 PSY 之间的蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用提高 Chlorella sorokiniana 中类胡萝卜素的产量。
articles.authors: Ma R, Li X, Meng X, Zhang Z, Chen Y, Zhang C, Wang L, Lu K, Li X, Song K, Ho SH, Chen J, Ng IS, Xie Y.
articles.abstract: The green microalga Chlorella sorokiniana FZU60, capable of achieving ultra-high biomass concentrations under heterotrophic conditions, is a promising chassis for carotenoid production. Enhancing intracellular carotenoid accumulation is an effective strategy to further improve the potential of this alga. ORANGE protein is recognized as a key post-transcriptional regulator of phytoene synthase (PSY), the rate-limiting enzyme in carotenoid biosynthesis, in higher plants. However, its function in microalgae remains unclear. In this study, the genomic structures of ORANGE and PSY in C. sorokiniana FZU60 (CsORANGE and CsPSY) were characterized, revealing GC-AG splice sites within their introns. Computational analysis predicted a stable interaction between CsORANGE and CsPSY, which was subsequently confirmed by yeast two-hybrid (Y2H) and bimolecular fluorescence complementation (BiFC) assays. Heterologous co-expression of CsORANGE and CsPSY in carotenoid-engineered Escherichia coli significantly increased lycopene accumulation compared with expression of CsPSY alone. Moreover, CRISPR activation (CRISPRa)-mediated upregulation of endogenous CsORANGE significantly enhanced carotenoid accumulation in the engineered transformants. These results demonstrate that CsORANGE positively regulates carotenoid biosynthesis via direct protein-protein interaction with CsPSY in C. sorokiniana FZU60.
articles.abstractZh: 绿色微藻 Chlorella sorokiniana FZU60 能够在异养条件下实现超高生物量浓度，是类胡萝卜素生产的有前途的基础。增强细胞内类胡萝卜素积累是进一步提高这种藻类潜力的有效策略。 ORANGE 蛋白被认为是高等植物中八氢番茄红素合酶 (PSY) 的关键转录后调节因子，PSY 是类胡萝卜素生物合成的限速酶。然而，其在微藻中的功能仍不清楚。在本研究中，对 C. sorokiniana FZU60（CsORANGE 和 CsPSY）中 ORANGE 和 PSY 的基因组结构进行了表征，揭示了其内含子内的 GC-AG 剪接位点。计算分析预测 CsORANGE 和 CsPSY 之间存在稳定的相互作用，随后通过酵母双杂交 (Y2H) 和双分子荧光互补 (BiFC) 测定证实了这一点。与单独表达 CsPSY 相比，在类胡萝卜素工程大肠杆菌中异源共表达 CsORANGE 和 CsPSY 显着增加了番茄红素的积累。此外，CRISPR激活（CRISPRa）介导的内源性CsORANGE上调显着增强了类胡萝卜素的积累

articles.title: Gene Editing-Driven Engineering of Microbial Systems and Metabolites for Precision Medicine and Sustainable Environmental Remediation.
articles.authors: Du Y, Shi Y, Chen D, Wang S, Su J, Liu K, Zhang H, Wang F.
articles.abstract: The engineering of microorganisms is undergoing a fundamental paradigm shift, transitioning from the construction of static cell factories to the programming of dynamically responsive living materials. However, translating molecular interventions into robust macroscopic functions requires overcoming distinct microbial-specific barriers, including delivery bottlenecks and genetic stability. In this review, we establish a unified Edit-Reprogram-Functionalize conceptual framework that systematically delineates transient genetic regulation from permanent genomic engineering. We critically examine the evolutionary trajectories of five foundational technologies: plasmid engineering, CRISPR-Cas systems, base editors, prime editors, and enzyme engineering. Rather than analyzing these toolsets in isolation, we map their convergence into an integrated engineering continuum that drives the precise synthesis of two distinct output classes: engineered living microbial materials and robust microbial metabolite-derived materials. By evaluating representative breakthroughs-from ultrasound-actuated bacterial therapeutics to ultra-tough, biosynthesized protein composites-through the strict lens of host-dependent constraints, we reveal the mechanistic principles governing successful preclinical translation. Finally, we propose an actionable roadmap centered on systemic miniaturization, closed-loop control, and multi-scale integration, providing a definitive blueprint for the next generation of precision medicine, advanced biomanufacturing, and ecological remediation.

articles.title: Hac1-independent functions of Ire1 drive morphogenesis in Candida albicans through distinct transcriptional programs.
articles.titleZh: Ire1 的 Hac1 独立功能通过不同的转录程序驱动白色念珠菌的形态发生。
articles.authors: Stack-Couture S, Nunes Marsiglio Librais G, Lung B, Genereaux J, Halder V, Dumeaux V, Shapiro RS, Lajoie P.
articles.abstract: The pathogenic yeast Candida albicans relies on morphogenesis - the transition from spherical yeast to filamentous hyphal forms - for infection. Although morphogenesis requires Ire1, a transmembrane protein that canonically initiates the unfolded protein response (UPR) through HAC1 mRNA splicing, the specific mechanisms linking Ire1 to filamentation remain unclear. Using transcriptome analysis, we found that the Ire1-dependent transcriptional response driving morphogenesis was fundamentally distinct from the canonical UPR response to proteotoxic stress, with minimal overlap between programs. Morphogenesis was associated with only limited HAC1 splicing compared to the robust splicing seen during proteotoxic stress, and HAC1 deletion only partially impaired filamentation, unlike the near-complete loss observed with IRE1 deletion. These findings establish that Ire1 regulates hyphal development through previously uncharacterized HAC1-independent pathways. We identify cell wall integrity as a key HAC1-independent mechanism, with Ire1 - but not Hac1 - being essential for cell wall stress tolerance and upregulation of cell wall biosynthesis genes during filamentation. Our data also reveal Ire1-dependent decreases in transcripts encoding secretory proteins during both proteotoxic stress and morphogenesis, consistent with a possible role for Ire1-mediated mRNA degradation in these processes. Given the essential role of Ire1 in pathogenesis and extensive development of Ire1-targeting compounds for mammalian systems, our findings position Ire1 as a highly promising druggable target for novel antifungal therapeutics and development of fungal-specific inhibitors.
articles.abstractZh: 致病性酵母白色念珠菌依赖形态发生（从球形酵母到丝状菌丝形式的转变）进行感染。虽然形态发生需要 Ire1（一种跨膜蛋白，通过 HAC1 mRNA 剪接规范启动未折叠蛋白反应 (UPR)），但将 Ire1 与丝状化联系起来的具体机制仍不清楚。通过转录组分析，我们发现驱动形态发生的 Ire1 依赖性转录反应与典型的蛋白毒性应激 UPR 反应根本不同，程序之间的重叠最小。与蛋白毒性应激期间的稳健剪接相比，形态发生仅与有限的 HAC1 剪接相关，并且 HAC1 缺失仅部分损害丝化，这与 IRE1 缺失观察到的几乎完全丧失不同。这些发现证实 Ire1 通过以前未表征的 HAC1 独立途径调节菌丝发育。我们将细胞壁完整性确定为一个关键的 HAC1 独立机制，Ire1 但不是 Hac1 对于细胞壁应激耐受性和成丝过程中细胞壁生物合成基因的上调至关重要。我们的数据还揭示了 Ire1 依赖性的减少

articles.title: Harnessing natural diversity of <i>Saccharomyces cerevisiae</i> for enhanced resistance to weak acids.
articles.titleZh: 利用酿酒酵母的天然多样性来增强对弱酸的抵抗力。
articles.authors: My R, Corte L, Cardinali G, Favaro L.
articles.abstract: The production of second-generation bioethanol from lignocellulosic biomass is a promising solution for sustainable energy, yet it faces significant challenges also due to the inhibitory effects of weak acids released during biomass pretreatment, particularly acetic, formic and levulinic acids. This review describes the ability of Saccharomyces cerevisiae, with a focus on natural isolates, in overcoming these challenging compounds. Indeed, natural isolates exhibit greater genetic and phenotypic diversity than laboratory and industrial strains, offering unique traits such as enhanced stress tolerance, metabolic efficiency, and adaptive responses to weak acids. This investigation explores the transcriptional and genomic mechanisms underlying yeast adaptive responses, emphasizing key regulatory networks and resistance pathways, including drug H+ antiporters, Reactive Oxygen Species (ROS) mitigation strategies, and membrane composition adjustments. Strategies for strains improvement, involving adaptive laboratory evolution (ALE), genome shuffling, and hybridization, are also discussed as complementary approaches to develop robust yeast capable of thriving under stressful industrial fermentation conditions. The integration of these techniques, along with genomic and transcriptomic insights, provides a comprehensive framework for engineering high-performance yeast strains. Ultimately, this review underscores the potential of leveraging natural diversity and innovative biotechnological strategies to advance the scalability and efficiency of lignocellulosic bioethanol production through S. cerevisiae fermentation.
articles.abstractZh: 利用木质纤维素生物质生产第二代生物乙醇是可持续能源的一种有前途的解决方案，但由于生物质预处理过程中释放的弱酸，特别是乙酸、甲酸和乙酰丙酸的抑制作用，它也面临着重大挑战。这篇综述描述了酿酒酵母（重点关注天然分离物）克服这些具有挑战性的化合物的能力。事实上，天然分离株比实验室和工业菌株表现出更大的遗传和表型多样性，提供独特的性状，例如增强的应激耐受性、代谢效率和对弱酸的适应性反应。这项研究探讨了酵母适应性反应背后的转录和基因组机制，强调关键的调控网络和耐药途径，包括药物 H+ 反向转运蛋白、活性氧 (ROS) 缓解策略和膜成分调整。还讨论了菌株改良策略，包括适应性实验室进化 (ALE)、基因组改组和杂交，作为开发能够在工业压力下茁壮成长的强健酵母的补充方法。

articles.title: Mitochondrial engineering strategies in yeast cell factories.
articles.titleZh: 酵母细胞工厂的线粒体工程策略。
articles.authors: Yang S, Gao C, Hu G, Li X, Liu L.
articles.abstract: Yeast is widely used as a microbial chassis for sustainable chemical production, with subcellular organelles helping to organize and regulate biosynthesis. Among these organelles, mitochondria play pivotal roles in yeast cell factories by supplying metabolic resources, maintaining cellular vitality, and providing a favorable biosynthetic microenvironment. Accordingly, this review summarizes mitochondria-centered strategies for improving yeast-based chemical production. These strategies include (i) rewiring mitochondrial metabolic pathways to regulate metabolic resource supply; (ii) maintaining mitochondrial homeostasis to improve cellular vitality; and (iii) optimizing mitochondrial compartmentalization. Current bottlenecks and future opportunities are discussed, providing a framework for optimizing chemical biosynthesis in yeast cell factories.
articles.abstractZh: 酵母被广泛用作可持续化学生产的微生物底盘，其亚细胞细胞器有助于组织和调节生物合成。在这些细胞器中，线粒体通过提供代谢资源、维持细胞活力并提供有利的生物合成微环境，在酵母细胞工厂中发挥着关键作用。因此，这篇综述总结了以线粒体为中心的改善酵母化学生产的策略。这些策略包括（i）重新连接线粒体代谢途径以调节代谢资源供应； (ii) 维持线粒体稳态以提高细胞活力； (iii) 优化线粒体区室化。讨论了当前的瓶颈和未来的机遇，为优化酵母细胞工厂的化学生物合成提供了框架。

articles.title: Strain-dependent metabolic remodelling by indigenous yeasts from fermented sausages enhances saltiness responses in a low-NaCl meat slurry model.
articles.authors: Li H, Li Y, Zhao Y, Wu M, Yu Q, Sun C, Zhao Z, Wen R.
articles.abstract: This study evaluated five indigenous yeasts (Candida zeylanoides DQ7, Pichia kudriavzevii MDJ1, Torulaspora delbrueckii HG7, Debaryomyces hansenii SH4, and Yarrowia lipolytica SH1) for saltiness-related flavour modulation in a low-NaCl meat slurry model. All inoculated yeasts proliferated and enhanced saltiness, umami, and richness to varying degrees. Strain-specific metabolic signatures were observed, including nucleotide turnover in T. delbrueckii HG7, peptide/nitrogen remodelling in P. kudriavzevii MDJ1, oligopeptide enrichment in Y. lipolytica SH1, lipid-derived transformation in C. zeylanoides DQ7, and integrated amino acid, nucleotide, and organic acid redistribution in D. hansenii SH4. Yeast inoculation shifted volatile profiles from aldehyde-dominated oxidative notes towards fermentation-associated alcohols, esters, ketones, furans, and sulphur-containing compounds. Correlation analysis identified 59 non-volatile metabolites and 30 volatiles positively associated with saltiness, umami, and richness, particularly furans and sulphur compounds. Integrated pathway mapping suggested a multi-module metabolic network in which nucleotide turnover, amino acid redistribution, lipid-derived volatiles, and glutathione-mediated redox regulation were associated with saltiness enhancement. These findings support taste-aroma metabolic coupling as a basis for yeast-assisted sodium reduction in fermented meats.

articles.title: A versatile yeast platform for N-demethylation of therapeutic alkaloids.
articles.titleZh: 用于治疗性生物碱 N-去甲基化的多功能酵母平台。
articles.authors: Yaw DJ, Li X, Kampmann KB, Lam KWL, Xue S, Hansen J, Bowser TA, Kentish SE, Gras SL.
articles.abstract: Alkaloid N-demethylation is a critical step in the production of many semi-synthetic alkaloid therapeutics and has traditionally relied on synthetic chemical routes. Microbial whole-cell bioproduction offers a promising alternate route for generating these valuable pharmaceuticals. This work demonstrated a greener N-demethylation platform applicable to morphinan and tropine alkaloid classes, employing an engineered yeast expressing a cytochrome P450 enzyme with N-demethylase activity, a cytochrome P450 oxidoreductase and purine permeases as transporters. This platform enabled the N-demethylation of the morphinan alkaloids, oripavine and thebaine with high activity, and the tropane alkaloids, atropine and scopolamine with moderate activity. The study systematically evaluated the contributions of substrate uptake and enzymatic conversion within the whole-cell system. Heterologous transporters enabled mass transfer across the cell membrane, with no significant difference detected for the four substrates, while in vitro enzyme catalysis differed between substrates and correlated with yield. Computational molecular docking, combined with deep learning-based protein structure prediction, found all four substrates had high affinity for the enzyme. This approach was also used to identify potential target substrates for future biotransformation. Process performance could be further improved with the use of larger scale, well controlled bioreactors.
articles.abstractZh: 生物碱 N-去甲基化是许多半合成生物碱治疗剂生产中的关键步骤，传统上依赖于合成化学路线。微生物全细胞生物生产为生产这些有价值的药物提供了一条有前途的替代途径。这项工作展示了一个适用于吗啡喃和托品生物碱类的更环保的 N-去甲基化平台，采用表达具有 N-去甲基化酶活性的细胞色素 P450 酶、细胞色素 P450 氧化还原酶和嘌呤渗透酶作为转运蛋白的工程酵母。该平台能够对高活性的吗啡喃生物碱、东罂粟碱和蒂巴因以及中等活性的托烷生物碱、阿托品和东莨菪碱进行N-去甲基化。该研究系统地评估了全细胞系统内底物吸收和酶转化的贡献。异源转运蛋白能够跨细胞膜进行传质，四种底物没有检测到显着差异，而体外酶催化作用在底物之间存在差异，并且与产量相关。计算分子对接，结合基于深度学习的蛋白质结构预测，

articles.title: Bioethanol Production from Taberau (Phragmites australis) Biomass via Coriolopsis caperata Delignification and MIL-100(Fe)-Immobilized Saccharomyces cerevisiae Fermentation.
articles.titleZh: 通过 Coriolopsis caperata 脱木质素和 MIL-100(Fe) 固定化酿酒酵母发酵从 Taberau（芦苇）生物质生产生物乙醇。
articles.authors: Atikah TA, Asi Y, Yuliana Y, Jefriyanto W, Tesalonika L, Krissilvio EJ, Agnestisia R.
articles.abstract: This study explored bioethanol production from Taberau lignocellulosic biomass through fungal delignification, enzymatic hydrolysis, and fermentation using MIL-100(Fe)-immobilized yeast. The fungal pre-treatment with Coriolopsis caperata enhanced laccase activity, reaching a maximum of 520 U/L at 12 days, and significantly reduced lignin content from 20.87% to 10.92%. This reduction improved cellulose accessibility and increased the availability of fermentable sugars during hydrolysis. Enzymatic hydrolysis results showed that fungal-treated biomass produced higher reducing sugar concentrations compared to untreated and control samples, indicating effective lignin removal. Fermentation was conducted under various conditions, with optimal ethanol production achieved at a yeast dosage of 2% (w/v) and a fermentation time of 4 days, resulting in an ethanol concentration of 11.57 g/L. Characterization using FTIR, XRD, and SEM confirmed successful immobilization of yeast on MIL-100(Fe) without structural degradation. The immobilized system demonstrated improved stability and reusability compared to free yeast. The obtained ethanol concentration is within the typical range for SHF-based lignocellulosic bioethanol production. The integration of fungal pre-treatment with MOF-based immobilization provides a promising and sustainable strategy, with potential for further improvement through process optimization and alternative fermentation approaches.
articles.abstractZh: 本研究探索了通过真菌脱木质素、酶水解和使用 MIL-100(Fe) 固定化酵母发酵从 Taberau 木质纤维素生物质生产生物乙醇。用 Coriolopsis caperata 预处理真菌增强了漆酶活性，在 12 天时达到最大值 520 U/L，并显着降低木质素含量，从 20.87% 降至 10.92%。这种减少提高了纤维素的可及性并增加了水解过程中可发酵糖的可用性。酶水解结果表明，与未经处理的样品和对照样品相比，经真菌处理的生物质产生更高的还原糖浓度，表明有效去除木质素。在各种条件下进行发酵，在酵母剂量为 2% (w/v) 和发酵时间为 4 天时实现了最佳乙醇产量，得到的乙醇浓度为 11.57 g/L。使用 FTIR、XRD 和 SEM 进行表征证实酵母成功固定在 MIL-100(Fe) 上，且没有结构降解。与游离酵母相比，固定化系统表现出更高的稳定性和可重复使用性。获得的乙醇浓度在 SHF 基锂的典型范围内

articles.title: Comparative Effects of Bacterial and Yeast Fermentation on Nutritional & Bioactive Properties in Chickpea Protein Isolate.
articles.titleZh: 细菌和酵母发酵对鹰嘴豆分离蛋白营养和生物活性特性的比较影响。
articles.authors: Özsoy B, Bıyıklı B, Yay C, Aslan Ö, Kibar EAA, Hoşoğlu Mİ.
articles.abstract: Microbial fermentation of legume proteins and legume-based ingredients is increasingly recognized as an effective strategy for developing innovative food products with improved nutritional and functional properties. Accordingly, this study aimed to comparatively evaluate the effects of fermenting chickpea protein isolate (CPI) using the lactic acid bacterium Lactobacillus helveticus, the bacterium Bacillus subtilis, and the yeast Kluyveromyces marxianus on its antioxidant capacity, nutritional quality, and protein molecular weight distribution. Microbial growth occurred predominantly within the first 24 h and differed significantly among microorganisms, with B. subtilis (2.7 ± 0.1 log CFU/mL increase) showing the highest and L. helveticus (0.9 ± 0.1 log CFU/mL increase) showing the lowest increase. Despite the reduction in certain amino acids, fermentation increased the essential-to-total amino acid ratio in all samples, with the greatest enhancement observed in Bacillus-fermented products. While antioxidant activity markedly enhanced following B. subtilis fermentation in DPPH, ABTS, and CUPRAC assays, K. marxianus and L. helveticus did not induce significant changes compared to the control sample, with total phenolic content remaining statistically unchanged across all groups. Fermentation also reduced phytic acid content from 44.5 μg/100 mL in the control sample to 38.3 μg/100 mL (14%) with B. subtilis, 30.5 μg/100 mL (31%) with K. marxianus, and most markedly to 13.3 μg/100 mL (70%) with L. helveticus, while condensed tannins exhibited only minor reductions, decreasing from 3.20 to 2.68 mg catechin/100 mL.
articles.abstractZh: 豆类蛋白质和豆类成分的微生物发酵越来越被认为是开发具有改善营养和功能特性的创新食品的有效策略。因此，本研究旨在比较评估使用乳酸菌瑞士乳杆菌、枯草芽孢杆菌和马克斯克鲁维酵母发酵鹰嘴豆分离蛋白（CPI）对其抗氧化能力、营养品质和蛋白质分子量分布的影响。微生物生长主要发生在前 24 小时内，并且微生物之间存在显着差异，其中枯草芽孢杆菌（增加 2.7 ± 0.1 log CFU/mL）显示最高，瑞士乳杆菌（增加 0.9 ± 0.1 log CFU/mL）显示最低增加。尽管某些氨基酸减少了，但发酵增加了所有样品中必需氨基酸与总氨基酸的比例，其中在芽孢杆菌发酵产品中观察到的增强幅度最大。虽然在 DPPH、ABTS 和 CUPRAC 测定中，枯草芽孢杆菌发酵后抗氧化活性显着增强，但与马克斯克鲁维酵母和瑞士乳杆菌相比，并没有引起显着变化。

articles.title: Cyprosulfamide mitigates nicosulfuron phytotoxicity in maize through activation of GST-associated phase II detoxification involving ZmGST24.
articles.titleZh: Cyprosulfamide 通过激活涉及 ZmGST24 的 GST 相关 II 期解毒作用来减轻玉米中的烟嘧磺隆植物毒性。
articles.authors: Shao D, Wen X, Xu X, Liu X, Guo B, Li B, Wang G, Liu X, Men S.
articles.abstract: BackgroundNicosulfuron is an acetolactate synthase (ALS)-inhibiting herbicide widely used in maize production. However, under unfavorable environmental conditions, its phytotoxicity to maize remains a practical concern. Cyprosulfamide (CSA) is an effective safener for maize, yet the contribution of glutathione S-transferases (GST)-associated phase II detoxification to CSA-conferred protection against nicosulfuron injury remains poorly understood.ResultsCSA markedly alleviated nicosulfuron-induced growth inhibition in maize seedlings and effectively reduced herbicide injury under field conditions. Inhibitor assays showed that both cytochrome P450-mediated phase I metabolism and GST-associated phase II detoxification contribute to maize tolerance to nicosulfuron. Proteomic analysis further revealed that, relative to nicosulfuron treatment alone, co-application of nicosulfuron and CSA significantly enriched the glutathione metabolism pathway in maize leaves. Among the induced GST candidate genes, ZmGST24 showed the strongest transcriptional response. Phylogenetic and conserved motif analyses supported its functional similarity to previously reported GSTs involved in herbicide detoxification. Molecular docking suggested favorable binding of ZmGST24 to nicosulfuron, and heterologous expression in yeast demonstrated that ZmGST24 not only enhanced tolerance to nicosulfuron, but also increased tolerance to several herbicides commonly used in maize fields.ConclusionThese findings indicate that the protective effect of CSA against nicosulfuron phytotoxicity in maize is associated with activation of GST-associated phase II detoxification. The pronounced response of the glutathione metabolism pathway, together with the functional characterization of ZmGST24, identifies this gene as a promising candidate involved in CSA-induced herbicide tolerance and as a potential target for improving herbicide safety in maize. © 2026 Society of Chemical Industry.
articles.abstractZh: 背景烟嘧磺隆是一种乙酰乳酸合酶（ALS）抑制性除草剂，广泛用于玉米生产。然而，在不利的环境条件下，其对玉米的植物毒性仍然是一个实际问题。环丙磺酰胺（CSA）是一种有效的玉米安全剂，但谷胱甘肽S-转移酶（GST）相关的II期解毒对CSA赋予的烟嘧磺隆损伤保护作用的贡献仍知之甚少。结果CSA显着减轻了烟嘧磺隆对玉米幼苗的生长抑制，并有效减少了田间条件下的除草剂损伤。抑制剂测定表明，细胞色素 P450 介导的 I 期代谢和 GST 相关的 II 期解毒均有助于玉米对烟嘧磺隆的耐受性。蛋白质组学分析进一步表明，相对于单独使用烟嘧磺隆处理，烟嘧磺隆和CSA联合施用显着丰富了玉米叶片中谷胱甘肽代谢途径。在诱导的 GST 候选基因中，ZmGST24 显示出最强的转录反应。系统发育和保守基序分析支持其与之前报道的参与除草剂解毒的 GST 的功能相似性

articles.title: Gene Editing in <i>Chlamydomonas</i> Using the SCREAM Technique.
articles.authors: Ross IL, Hankamer B.
articles.abstract: In the model alga Chlamydomonas reinhardtii, CRISPR (clustered regularly interspaced short palindromic repeat)-based gene editing using Cas (CRISPR-associated) enzymes enables both (a) insertion of large gene cassettes and (b) the creation of knockouts based on the introduction of indels, and specific mutations via mutation-directing oligonucleotides. Owing to the relatively low efficiency of this process, selection markers are frequently used to enrich the candidate pool prior to screening, which typically employs PCR. Unfortunately, few selection markers are available for Chlamydomonas. Furthermore, each marker requires different selection media, and deletion of the selectable marker can be difficult. When multiple successive gene editing steps are required, the use of these markers becomes onerous. The SCREAM (sequential CRISPR via recycling endogenous auxotrophic markers) technique employs an endogenous gene as a marker, the mutation of which can be selected both in the forward (loss of function) and reverse (gain of function) directions. During the first gene editing step, crRNA and mutation-directing oligonucleotides are provided for both the marker and the first target gene (Target 1). Candidates with edited marker genes are selected by loss of marker function, prior to screening for the desired modification of the first target gene. Using a successful candidate, a subsequent gene editing step directs reversion of the mutant marker gene to wild-type status, with candidates being selected on auxotrophic media to detect the regain of function of the auxotrophic marker to wild type (i.e., reversion). Simultaneously, a second target gene modification is produced using Target 2-specific crRNA and oligonucleotides. Revertants, now with a wild-type auxotrophic marker, are then screened for the specific mutation of Target 2. This reversion strategy enables a single selectable marker to be reused indefinitely, facilitating the creation of many successive mutations in a single cell line. As the marker can be completely reconstituted, strains can be created in which only the target gene is altered. Employment of homology-directed repair, using single-stranded oligonucleotides for mutation creation, enables the creation of site-directed mutants, tag insertion, and gene knockouts or reversion, rather than the insertion of large gene cassettes. In this implementation, nitrate reductase is used as the endogenous auxotrophic marker, and the adenine phosphoribosyltransferase gene is used as an example of a target gene. Key features • A single endogenous selectable marker gene is used for all successive mutational steps, employing only two standardized selection media. • An indefinite series of gene edits created in a single cell line enables functional analysis of redundant gene families. • Suitable applications include gene tagging, gene knockout, restoration of mutated genes to wild type, and site-directed mutagenesis to study gene function. • Widely applicable to existing cell lines.

articles.title: Integrated microbiome and metabolome analyses reveal spatial heterogeneity of medium-temperature Daqu and its potential impact on simulated strong-flavor baijiu fermentation.
articles.authors: Wen Z, Wei YH, Zhu HY, Song L, Han DY, Guo LC, He CJ, Guo ZX, Han PJ.
articles.abstract: Medium-temperature Daqu (MTD) exhibits pronounced spatial heterogeneity between its surface (QS) and inner (QI) portions, yet their functional differences remain poorly understood. This study compared physicochemical properties, metabolites, and species-level microbial communities of QS and QI and evaluated their impacts on simulated strong-flavor Baijiu (SFB) fermentation. QS exhibited higher saccharification and liquefaction activities and higher counts of lactic acid bacteria and yeasts, whereas QI was enriched in thermophilic molds and volatile compounds. Thirty-two microbial biomarkers differentiated QS and QI, and QS showed a more complex microbial co-occurrence pattern. Simulated fermentation revealed early bacterial divergence followed by convergence to Acetilactobacillus jinshanensis. During mid-to-late fermentation, QI showed higher levels of acids and esters than QS. Collectively, QS was mainly associated with substrate conversion and early fermentation initiation, whereas QI was more closely associated with flavor development during later fermentation stages. These findings provide valuable insights into MTD optimization and SFB quality control.

articles.title: OsERF101-OsACO1 module acts a negative regulator of salinity resistance in rice by modulating ethylene-associated ROS homeostasis.
articles.titleZh: OsERF101-OsACO1 模块通过调节乙烯相关的 ROS 稳态，对水稻的耐盐性起到负调节作用。
articles.authors: Xiong J, Zheng W, Zhu T, Wang H, Peng Y, Shao Y, Zhao B, Mao B.
articles.abstract: Soil salinity severely constrains rice productivity worldwide. As an essential phytohormone, ethylene participates in the developmental processes and stress adaptation of plants; however, the regulatory mechanisms linking ethylene biosynthesis to salt tolerance in rice remain incompletely understood. Here, we demonstrate that the ethylene biosynthesis gene OsACO1 and the AP2/ERF transcription factor OsERF101 negatively regulate salinity tolerance in seedlings. The CRISPR/Cas9-mediated knockout mutants, osaco1 and oserf101, exhibited significantly enhanced survival under 150 mM NaCl treatment, along with reduced reactive oxygen species (ROS) accumulation and enhanced antioxidative enzymatic activity. Transcriptome profiling revealed that salt-treated osaco1 seedlings displayed extensive transcriptional reprogramming, including upregulation of genes involved in ion homeostasis, ROS detoxification, hormone signaling (JA/ABA/ET), transcriptional regulation, and stress defense. A salt-responsive module associated with the osaco1 genotype was detected using weighted gene co-expression network analysis. Promoter motif enrichment and intersection analyses highlighted AP2/ERF transcription factors as key regulatory candidates. The direct interaction between OsERF101 and the GCC-box element within the OsACO1 promoter and the transcriptional activation of OsACO1 expression were confirmed through yeast one-hybrid, dual-luciferase reporter, and electrophoretic mobility shift assays. Collectively, our results support a model in which OsERF101 positively regulates OsACO1 expression, thereby modulating ethylene-associated ROS homeostasis and hormone crosstalk to fine-tune salt stress responses. Our findings elucidate the mechanisms underlying the ethylene-driven regulation of salinity resistance in rice and identify potential targets for molecular breeding of salinity-tolerant cultivars.
articles.abstractZh: 土壤盐分严重限制了全球水稻产量。乙烯作为一种必需的植物激素，参与植物的发育过程和逆境适应；然而，乙烯生物合成与水稻耐盐性之间的调控机制仍不完全清楚。在这里，我们证明乙烯生物合成基因 OsACO1 和 AP2/ERF 转录因子 OsERF101 对幼苗的耐盐性负调节。 CRISPR/Cas9 介导的敲除突变体 osaco1 和 osef101 在 150 mM NaCl 处理下表现出显着增强的存活率，同时减少了活性氧 (ROS) 的积累并增强了抗氧化酶活性。转录组分析显示，盐处理的 osaco1 幼苗表现出广泛的转录重编程，包括离子稳态、ROS 解毒、激素信号传导 (JA/ABA/ET)、转录调控和应激防御相关基因的上调。使用加权基因共表达网络分析检测到与 osaco1 基因型相关的盐响应模块。启动子基序富集和交叉分析突出显示了 AP2/ERF 转录

articles.title: PcRAV2 facilitates MeJA-induced anthocyanin biosynthesis by modulating PcMYB108 and PcUFGT in pear.
articles.titleZh: PcRAV2 通过调节梨中的 PcMYB108 和 PcUFGT 促进 MeJA 诱导的花青素生物合成。
articles.authors: Zhang G, Guo L, Cao H, Chen L, Tang Y, Zhai R, Yang C, Xu L, Wang Z.
articles.abstract: Anthocyanins are important plant pigments responsible for attractive coloration and for enhancing tolerance to various abiotic stresses. Their biosynthesis is known to be regulated by methyl jasmonate (MeJA). Although the promotive effect of MeJA on anthocyanin accumulation has been widely reported, the underlying regulatory mechanisms remain insufficiently understood. In this study, we identified an ethylene-responsive factor (ERF) family transcription factor, PcRAV2, that responds to MeJA signaling and enhances anthocyanin accumulation. PcMYB10, a central gene that positively regulates anthocyanin accumulation, was indirectly activated by PcRAV2. In addition, yeast one-hybrid library screening revealed that PcMYB108 functions upstream of PcMYB10 and acts as a negative regulator of anthocyanin biosynthesis; notably, PcMYB108 expression was suppressed by PcRAV2. Furthermore, PcRAV2 directly activated PcUFGT expression by binding to its promoter. Collectively, PcRAV2 promotes anthocyanin biosynthesis through two pathways: the PcRAV2-PcMYB108-PcMYB10 transcriptional cascade and the PcRAV2-PcUFGT regulatory pathway. These findings reveal a novel MeJA-driven regulatory pathway for anthocyanin biosynthesis in plants and provide a theoretical basis for the genetic improvement of fruit coloration in pear.
articles.abstractZh: 花青素是重要的植物色素，具有吸引人的色彩并增强对各种非生物胁迫的耐受性。已知它们的生物合成受茉莉酸甲酯 (MeJA) 的调节。尽管 MeJA 对花青素积累的促进作用已被广泛报道，但其潜在的调节机制仍不清楚。在这项研究中，我们鉴定了乙烯反应因子 (ERF) 家族转录因子 PcRAV2，它响应 MeJA 信号传导并增强花青素积累。 PcMYB10 是正向调节花青素积累的中心基因，被 PcRAV2 间接激活。此外，酵母单杂交文库筛选表明，PcMYB108在PcMYB10的上游发挥作用，并作为花青素生物合成的负调节因子；值得注意的是，PcMYB108 的表达被 PcRAV2 抑制。此外，PcRAV2 通过与其启动子结合直接激活 PcUFGT 表达。总的来说，PcRAV2 通过两条途径促进花青素生物合成：PcRAV2-PcMYB108-PcMYB10 转录级联和 PcRAV2-PcUFGT 调控途径。这些发现揭示了一种新的 MeJA 驱动的花药调节途径

articles.title: Time-resolved transcriptomics reveals ABA-related regulation and phenylpropanoid responses in Herpetospermum pedunculosum roots under salt stress.
articles.titleZh: 时间分辨转录组学揭示了盐胁迫下 Herpetospermum pedunculosum 根中 ABA 相关的调节和苯丙素反应。
articles.authors: Tao Y, Huang X, Zhang E, Jiang Q, Zhu Z, Chen D, Yao S, Zhu Z, Yang Y, Wang Z, Tan B, Ren D, Liu B, Li R, Sun M, Zhao Q.
articles.abstract: Salt stress is a major abiotic factor limiting plant growth and productivity. Herpetospermum pedunculosum, a medicinal plant adapted to high-altitude environments, offers a unique non-model system for investigating salt stress responses. Here, we combined physiological and biochemical assays with time-course root transcriptome profiling to characterize the responses of H. pedunculosum to 200 mM NaCl treatment. Salt stress induced rapid wilting, oxidative stress-related physiological changes, membrane damage, and significant accumulation of ABA, total lignin, and total lignans. RNA-seq across five time points (1, 3, 24, 48, and 96 h) identified nearly 28,000 differentially expressed genes (DEGs), which formed distinct temporal clusters associated with hormone signaling, transcriptional regulation, stress responses, and phenylpropanoid-related metabolism. Antioxidant enzyme-related genes, ABA biosynthesis/homeostasis genes, ABA signaling components, and lignin/lignan pathway biosynthesis genes (LLPBGs) showed stage-specific expression patterns, with several genes responding rapidly during the early phase of salt stress. WGCNA and co-expression analyses further identified trait-associated modules and candidate links among core TFs, ABA-related genes, and LLPBGs. Subcellular localization, yeast transactivation, Y1H and Dual-LUC assays provided preliminary evidence that the AP2/ERF factor HpERF141 can bind to and activate the promoter of the previously characterized lignan-related gene HpDIR17. Overall, this study provides a root-focused transcriptomic resource and identifies candidate regulatory genes potentially linking ABA-related responses with lignin/lignan-associated metabolism in H. pedunculosum under salt stress.
articles.abstractZh: 盐胁迫是限制植物生长和生产力的主要非生物因素。 Herpetospermum pedunculosum 是一种适应高海拔环境的药用植物，为研究盐胁迫反应提供了独特的非模型系统。在这里，我们将生理生化测定与根转录组时程分析相结合，以表征 H. pedunculosum 对 200 mM NaCl 处理的反应。盐胁迫引起快速枯萎、氧化应激相关的生理变化、膜损伤以及ABA、总木质素和总木脂素的显着积累。跨越五个时间点（1、3、24、48 和 96 小时）的 RNA-seq 鉴定出近 28,000 个差异表达基因 (DEG)，这些基因形成与激素信号传导、转录调控、应激反应和苯丙素相关代谢相关的不同时间簇。抗氧化酶相关基因、ABA生物合成/稳态基因、ABA信号成分和木质素/木脂素途径生物合成基因(LLPBG)表现出阶段特异性的表达模式，其中一些基因在盐胁迫的早期阶段快速响应。 WGCNA 和共表达分析进一步确定了性状关联

articles.title: Advances in Betalain Biosynthesis and Metabolic Engineering for Sustainable Natural Pigment Production.
articles.titleZh: 可持续天然色素生产的甜菜碱生物合成和代谢工程进展。
articles.authors: Monisha S, Kanchana M, Balasubramanian A, Selvakesavan RK.
articles.abstract: Betalains are water-soluble pigments containing nitrogen, and they exist naturally in the plants of the order Caryophyllales. They have gained increasing attention in recent years because of their intense colours, antioxidant activity, and safety, thus making them suitable replacements for artificial dyes. The increasing interest in natural pigments has led to intensified research on betalain biosynthesis and optimization of pigment production. Nonetheless, their application in industry faces limitations, such as their low natural occurrence, sensitivity to environmental conditions, and instability during manufacturing and storage. Unlike previous reviews that primarily focused on betalain chemistry, biosynthesis pathways, or biological activity, the present review highlights recent developments in the engineering of the biosynthesis pathways, synthetic biology, elicitation approaches, omics-based pathway identification, and nanobiotechnology for betalain pigments. Special attention is paid to the comparison of plant, plant cell, yeast, and bacterial production systems, as well as recent advancements towards industrial production of betalain pigments and bottlenecks in the commercialization of sustainable betalain bio-factories.
articles.abstractZh: 甜菜碱是含氮的水溶性色素，天然存在于石竹目植物中。近年来，它们因其浓郁的色彩、抗氧化活性和安全性而受到越来越多的关注，从而成为人造染料的合适替代品。人们对天然色素的兴趣日益浓厚，导致对甜菜红素生物合成和色素生产优化的研究不断深入。然而，它们在工业中的应用面临着局限性，例如它们的自然发生率低、对环境条件敏感以及制造和储存过程中的不稳定。与之前主要关注甜菜红素化学、生物合成途径或生物活性的综述不同，本综述重点介绍了甜菜红素色素生物合成途径工程、合成生物学、诱导方法、基于组学的途径识别和纳米生物技术的最新进展。特别关注植物、植物细胞、酵母和细菌生产系统的比较，以及甜菜碱色素工业生产的最新进展和商业瓶颈。

articles.title: Domain shuffling of endolysin LysKB317 to control <i>Limosilactobacillus fermentum</i> in corn mash fermentation.
articles.titleZh: 内溶素 LysKB317 的结构域改组控制玉米醪发酵中的发酵柠檬酸杆菌。
articles.authors: Lu SY, Wu ZL, Martinez MY, Patel MH, Skory CD.
articles.abstract: Lactic acid bacteria (LAB), such as Limosilactobacillus fermentum are persistent contaminants in bioethanol fermentation facilities and inhibit Saccharomyces cerevisiae, reducing ethanol yields. Rising resistance to antibiotics such as virginiamycin makes contamination control increasingly difficult. Recombinant endolysins such as LysKB317 provide a promising alternative. To improve LysKB317 performance, five variants were engineered by duplicating and rearranging its enzymatically active (EAD) and cell binding (CBD) domains. These constructs were compared to the wild-type endolysin. Differential scanning calorimetry (DSC) and bacterial lytic assays demonstrated that domain shuffling altered bacteriolytic activity and thermostability. The wild-type LysKB317 exhibited the highest initial lytic activity (1.16 × 10-4 OD/s‧µM), whereas LysKB317EADx3-CBD displayed comparable bacteriolytic kinetics (7.99 × 10-5 OD/s‧µM) and LysKB317CBD-EAD-CBD (ΔCp = 24.66 kJ/mol‧K) exhibited the greatest thermostability. Despite reduced activity, both variants effectively control LAB contaminants and prevented stalled corn mash fermentation. Domain shuffling demonstrated effective bacterial control strategy for generating novel endolysins for biocontrol.
articles.abstractZh: 发酵柠檬酸杆菌等乳酸菌 (LAB) 是生物乙醇发酵设施中的持久污染物，会抑制酿酒酵母，从而降低乙醇产量。对维吉尼亚霉素等抗生素的耐药性不断上升，使得污染控制变得越来越困难。 LysKB317 等重组细胞内溶素提供了一种有前景的替代方案。为了提高 LysKB317 的性能，通过复制和重新排列其酶活性 (EAD) 和细胞结合 (CBD) 结构域设计了五个变体。将这些构建体与野生型细胞内溶素进行比较。差示扫描量热法 (DSC) 和细菌溶解测定表明，结构域改组改变了溶菌活性和热稳定性。野生型LysKB317表现出最高的初始裂解活性（1.16×10-4 OD/s‧μM），而LysKB317EADx3-CBD表现出相当的溶菌动力学（7.99×10-5 OD/s‧μM），LysKB317CBD-EAD-CBD（ΔCp = 24.66 kJ/mol‧K）表现出最大的热稳定性。尽管活性降低，但这两种变体都能有效控制乳酸菌污染物并防止玉米醪发酵停滞。域改组证明了有效的细菌控制

articles.title: Efficient biosynthesis of ɑ-bisabolene in s. Cerevisiae by combinatorial regulation of acetyl-CoA supply, bisabolene synthase expression, and bisabolene transportation.
articles.titleZh: s 中 ɑ-红没药烯的高效生物合成。酿酒酵母通过乙酰辅酶A供应、红没药烯合酶表达和红没药烯运输的组合调节。
articles.authors: Wang X, Li D, Zhang Y, He N, Sun M, Yu H, Ye L.
articles.abstract: α-Bisabolene is an important precursor for fragrances, pharmaceuticals, and biofuels. This study presents a comprehensive metabolic engineering strategy to enhance α-bisabolene production in Saccharomyces cerevisiae. By integrating protein fusion expression, N-terminal fusion tags, dynamic regulation of competing pathways, acetyl-CoA supply enhancement, and endogenous transporter overexpression, we achieved a record α-bisabolene titer of 58.64 g/L in high-cell-density fermentation, with 95.7% extracellular proportion. Key innovations included the structural optimization (order adjustment and N-terminal modification) of the ERG20-AgBIS fusion protein to overcome downstream catalytic bottlenecks, the identification of yeast-endogenous PDR family proteins (Pdr1 and Snq2) for α-bisabolene efflux, and a systematic comparative analysis revealing the superiority of cytosolic over peroxisomal acetyl-CoA supply in S. cerevisiae. By sequentially integrating these downstream "pull" and upstream "push" strategies with diploid hybridization, this work provides a comprehensive, host-specific blueprint for optimizing high-value isoprenoids and underscores the feasibility of microbial biofuels.
articles.abstractZh: α-红没药烯是香料、药品和生物燃料的重要前体。本研究提出了一种综合代谢工程策略，以提高酿酒酵母中 α-红没药烯的产量。通过整合蛋白质融合表达、N端融合标签、竞争途径的动态调节、乙酰辅酶A供应增强和内源转运蛋白过表达，我们在高细胞密度发酵中实现了创纪录的58.64 g/L α-红没药烯滴度，胞外比例为95.7%。主要创新包括 ERG20-AgBIS 融合蛋白的结构优化（顺序调整和 N 端修饰）以克服下游催化瓶颈、鉴定用于 α-红没药烯外排的酵母内源 PDR 家族蛋白（Pdr1 和 Snq2），以及揭示酿酒酵母中细胞质相对于过氧化物酶体乙酰辅酶 A 供应的优越性的系统比较分析。通过将这些下游“拉”和上游“推”策略与二倍体杂交依次整合，这项工作为优化高价值类异戊二烯提供了一个全面的、特定于宿主的蓝图，并强调了微生物生物燃料的可行性。

articles.title: The FAD-Dependent Monooxygenase Albo65 Mediates Self-Resistance in Albofungin Biosynthesis.
articles.authors: Liu Z, Huang C, Xu H, Zhu L, Zhao H.
articles.abstract: The production of specialized small molecules in microorganisms often involves self-resistance mechanisms to prevent autotoxicity. Albofungins belong to the xanthone-containing aromatic polyketides with potent antimicrobial activities. However, its self-resistance mechanism remains unknown. Here we report the discovery of a flavin adenine dinucleotide (FAD)-dependent monooxygenase, Albo65, that mediates self-resistance in albofungin biosynthesis in Streptomyces monomycini NRRL B-24309. Deletion of albo65 resulted in almost no albofungin production and increased the sensitivity of the mutant strain to albofungin. Heterologous expression of albo65 in a nonproducing host increased the resistance of the host to albofungin. Biochemical studies showed that Albo65 catalyzes the oxidative inactivation of albofungin in vitro, and the resulting reaction mixture exhibited reduced antibacterial activity. Based on this discovery, the albofungin-albo65 pair was successfully developed as a highly sensitive selection system for yeasts. This work provides insights into the self-resistance mechanisms in albofungin biosynthesis and explores potential applications of Albo65 in basic and applied biological research.

articles.title: Comparative profiling of microbial community structure, enzyme potential, metabolic features, and volatile composition in craft and Jiafan Huangjiu processes.
articles.authors: Li S, Zhang H, Yang Y, Xia Y, Ni B, Ai L.
articles.abstract: Craft Huangjiu and Jiafan Huangjiu represent two distinct industrial Huangjiu product outcomes with contrasting volatile profiles. This study compared craft Huangjiu (L70) and Jiafan Huangjiu (L79) to characterize their physicochemical, microbial, gene-level functional, metabolic, and volatile features. Because L70 involved mid-fermentation addition of finished Huangjiu, this comparison was not intended to isolate the sole effect of fermentation interruption versus continued fermentation. L79 showed more extensive carbon and nitrogen utilization, with lower residual substrates and higher ethanol and acetic acid contents than L70, whereas L70 retained a less complete fermentation state. At the volatile level, GC-MS and volatile metabolomics consistently showed an ester-enriched profile in L79 and a more alcohol-dominant profile in L70. FlavorDB-based putative annotation and threshold-based OAV analysis further indicated distinct database-assigned descriptor distributions and potential odor-active compounds, with more OAV > 1 ester-related compounds in L79. Metagenomic analysis showed that L70 was dominated by Lactobacillus acetotolerans, whereas L79 contained higher relative abundances of Saccharomyces cerevisiae, Aspergillus oryzae, Aspergillus flavus, and Fructilactobacillus fructivorans. Metagenomic functional annotation showed higher representation of hydrolysis-related CAZy genes and ester-related enzyme annotations in L79. KEGG-based pathway mapping further indicated greater gene-level potential for ethanol-, acetate-, and acetyl-CoA-related metabolism in L79. Accordingly, the L70 profile should be interpreted as the integrated final-product outcome of process intervention, exogenous input, and subsequent fermentation. The findings provide a comparative basis for future flavor regulation and process optimization in Huangjiu and other fermented alcoholic beverages.

articles.title: Characterization of BrSTM16 from Brassica rapa and functional analysis of its role in regulating cold tolerance.
articles.titleZh: 白菜 BrSTM16 的表征及其耐冷调节作用的功能分析。
articles.authors: Zhang Y, Tao X, Zhao Y, Fahim AM, Li S, Xu Z, Wang Y, Sun H, Liu L, Wu J, Pu Y, Yang G, Wang W, Sun W, Ma L.
articles.abstract: The SHOOTMERISTEMLESS (STM) gene family controls shoot apical meristem homeostasis and participates in plant development and abiotic stress adaptation in higher plants. While the conserved roles of STM in maintaining meristem stability are well documented, the functions and regulatory mechanisms of BrSTM genes in Brassica rapa cold tolerance remain elusive, hindering our understanding of stress mediated meristem plasticity. Here, we systematically characterized the Brassica rapa STM gene family and identified 31 BrSTM members, all harboring the conserved KNOXⅠ domain and belonging to the class I KNOX family. Further functional analysis focused on the key candidate BrSTM16. Its promoter contains cold responsive and meristem specific regulatory elements, and the gene displays predominant expression in shoot apical meristems, with distinct tissue-specific and temperature dependent cold responses. Higher cold induction in cold-sensitive varieties indicates that BrSTM16 acts as a vital regulator linking meristem morphology and development to cold acclimation. Gene edited BrSTM16 mutants exhibited reduced survival rates and antioxidant enzyme activities under cold stress, confirming its positive role in regulating Brassica rapa cold tolerance. Transcriptome analysis suggested that BrSTM16 may modulate cold-induced metabolic homeostasis via the phenylpropanoid biosynthesis pathway. The disrupted expression of key pathway genes (PAL, 4CL, F5H) in knockout mutants was closely correlated with impaired cold resistance. Subcellular localization verified that BrSTM16 localizes to the nucleus. Six BrSTM16 interacting proteins with cold-responsive expression patterns were identified by yeast two-hybrid screening, and they participate in the BrSTM16 mediated cold-regulatory network. This study clarifies the characteristics of the BrSTM family and preliminarily reveals that BrSTM16 integrates phenylpropanoid metabolism and protein interaction networks in meristems to govern cold tolerance, providing reliable candidate genes and theoretical foundations for Brassica rapa cold-resistance molecular breeding.
articles.abstractZh: SHOOTMERISTEMLESS (STM) 基因家族控制茎尖分生组织稳态，并参与高等植物的植物发育和非生物胁迫适应。虽然STM在维持分生组织稳定性方面的保守作用已得到充分证明，但BrSTM基因在白菜耐冷性中的功能和调节机制仍然难以捉摸，这阻碍了我们对应激介导的分生组织可塑性的理解。在这里，我们系统地表征了白菜STM基因家族，并鉴定了31个BrSTM成员，它们都含有保守的KNOXⅠ结构域，属于I类KNOX家族。进一步的功能分析集中在关键候选 BrSTM16 上。其启动子含有冷响应和分生组织特异性调控元件，并且该基因在茎尖分生组织中表现出主要表达，具有独特的组织特异性和温度依赖性冷响应。冷敏感品种中较高的冷诱导表明 BrSTM16 作为将分生组织形态和发育与冷驯化联系起来的重要调节因子。基因编辑的 BrSTM16 突变体在冷应激下表现出较低的存活率和抗氧化酶活性，证实了其

articles.title: CRISPR/Cas9-assisted heterothallic conversion enables rapid hybridization of industrial Saccharomyces strains.
articles.titleZh: CRISPR/Cas9 辅助的异宗体转化能够实现工业酵母菌菌株的快速杂交。
articles.authors: Righetto F, Bosaro M, Sartori G, Granuzzo S, Antoniali P, Lopreiato R.
articles.abstract: Efficient yeast breeding remains a major bottleneck in industrial biotechnology, particularly in food and beverage applications, where strain improvement must balance phenotypic innovation with regulatory constraints. Traditional hybridization procedures for natural Saccharomyces strains are experimentally limited by their diploid and homothallic nature, often resulting in labor-intensive processes of unpredictable duration. Here, we developed and validated a CRISPR/Cas9-assisted breeding framework that enables rapid, systematic, and informative hybridization by transiently converting homothallic strains into stable heterothallic mating partners through targeted HO gene inactivation. Using this strategy, we generated and characterized multiple intraspecific and interspecific hybrids challenging some industrially relevant traits, as sulfur dioxide release, acetic acid production, and the ability to restart stuck fermentations. In all cases, we generated the hybrids and assessed their performance within three months. Hybrid phenotypes followed inheritance patterns including parental-like, intermediate, and combinatorial traits, enabling rapid evaluation of cross utility. Moreover, cisgenic hybrids were generated by the restoration of the native HO locus, maintaining identical fermentative performance. Application to Saccharomyces cerevisiae × Saccharomyces uvarum interspecific crosses further demonstrated the versatility of the approach while revealing intrinsic biological constraints on trait combination. Overall, CRISPR/Cas9-assisted heterothallic conversion emerges as a versatile platform for accelerated yeast breeding, providing decision-enabling insights that support informed strain development across fermentation-based industries.
articles.abstractZh: 高效酵母育种仍然是工业生物技术的主要瓶颈，特别是在食品和饮料应用中，菌株改良必须平衡表型创新与监管限制。天然酵母菌株的传统杂交程序在实验上受到其二倍体和同宗性性质的限制，常常导致劳动密集型过程的持续时间不可预测。在这里，我们开发并验证了 CRISPR/Cas9 辅助育种框架，该框架通过定向 HO 基因失活将同宗菌株瞬时转化为稳定的异宗交配伴侣，从而实现快速、系统和信息丰富的杂交。利用这种策略，我们生成并表征了多个种内和种间杂种，这些杂种挑战了一些工业相关性状，如二氧化硫释放、乙酸生产以及重新启动停滞发酵的能力。在所有情况下，我们都生成了混合体并在三个月内评估了它们的性能。杂交表型遵循遗传模式，包括亲本性状、中间性状和组合性状，从而能够快速评估交叉效用。此外，ci
